name: Pierce Magical Concealment (Combat)
body:
You can ignore the spells that seek to impede your attacks by obscuring your target.

Prerequisite(s): Blind-Fight, Mage Slayer.

Benefit: You may disregard the miss chance granted by magic items, spells or spell-like abilities such as darkness or blur. Additionally, you can identify the correct target if the spellcaster is affected by spells like mirror image or displacement.

This does not prevent miss chances from non-magical sources. You may not negate the effects of a spell, item or effect with a caster level of your character level +4.
